customer_persona: Rohit Chawla moved house and wants to change the address of a shipped order.
verification_notes: Hand-written and checked against data/policies and data/sops; labels written together with the dialogue.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Farah Khan. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Farah, I am Rohit Chawla. I moved to a new flat last week and I want to change the delivery address on an order I placed two days ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I would be glad to look into that, Mr. Chawla. First, could you please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, ORD-38760, and the last four digits are 6612.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. To make sure I understand, you would like to change the delivery address for order ORD-38760 because you have moved. Is that right?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand how inconvenient a house move can be, and I will personally help you find the best option. Let me check the order status.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can see the order is already in Shipped status. Address changes are only possible while an order is Confirmed or Processing, and once it is shipped, none of our agents has system permission to alter the address or recipient name.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh no. Is there nothing at all I can do? I will not be at the old address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There is one option. In such cases you can request a cancellation of this order and place a fresh order to your new address. Since the order has not been delivered yet, I can raise the cancellation request for you right now if you wish.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds fine. Please cancel it and I will reorder with the new address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done, I have raised the cancellation request under ticket SHP-77412. Our team will confirm the cancellation by SMS, and any amount paid will return to your original payment method.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thanks for explaining this clearly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarise, the address cannot be changed on a shipped order, the cancellation request is raised under ticket SHP-77412, and you can place a fresh order with your new address. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase, Mr. Chawla. Have a wonderful day and best wishes for your new home!
